_comment: Placeholders only. 'describe' (optional, write actions) is the plain sentence the approver reads; {param} placeholders are filled with the exact values. credential.ref names a root-only file under /etc/homeserver/gateway/creds/ (never the value). 'header' and 'prefix' say how the credential is sent. 'sensitive': true keeps param values out of the log. A param with 'secret': true is never sent to Trinity (the approver sees '(secret, not shown)'); a sensitive action that marks no param secret has every param treated as secret. Params used in the url go in the URL (percent-encoded); the rest of a non-GET call travel as a JSON body.
